definitions.explanation: Said of a man, or a man's behavior, judged weak, indecisive or unable to let go, such as a man who cannot get over an old girlfriend. A disparaging word built on an old stereotype of women.

examples.japanese: {女々|めめ}しいこと⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{言|い}う→言う：00515_iu⟧な。
⟦{別|わか}れた→別れる：01113_wakareru⟧⟦{彼女|かのじょ}→彼女：01286_kanojo⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{写真|しゃしん}→写真：00753_shashin⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{見|み}ている→見る：00283_miru⟧⟦なんて→なんて：06918_nante⟧{女々|めめ}しい。
examples.english: Staring at photos of your ex-girlfriend is pathetic.

examples.japanese: ⟦{失敗|しっぱい}→失敗：01636_shippai⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦いつ→いつ：00536_itsu⟧⟦まで→まで：00490_made⟧⟦も→も：00484_mo⟧⟦{人|ひと}→人：00476_hito⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧せい⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦する→する：00392_suru⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧{女々|めめ}しい⟦と→と：00512_to⟧⟦{父|ちち}→父：00566_chichi⟧⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦{叱|しか}られた→叱る：01202_shikaru⟧。
examples.english: My father scolded me, saying it was spineless to keep blaming others for my failure.

notes:
{女|め} (woman, old reading) doubled, + しい. 々 repeats the kanji.

USAGE:
Almost always aimed at men. It mostly criticizes clinging to the past, complaining, or lack of resolve, rather than appearance. Because it equates weakness with women, it is avoided in careful speech; ⟦{未練|みれん}がましい→未練がましい：26851_mirengamashii⟧ (clinging, unable to let go) or ⟦{情|なさ}けない→情けない：03129_nasakenai⟧ (pathetic) say the same without the gender.

SIMILAR WORDS:
- ⟦{男|おとこ}→男：00561_otoko⟧らしい: manly; the usual opposite
- {雄々|おお}しい: brave, manly; formal and literary
